name: Judah
role: Son of Jacob and Leah, ancestor of the tribe and of David
summary: Leah's fourth son. He proposed selling Joseph rather than killing him; after his sons Er and Onan died, he withheld his third son from their widow Tamar, and she, veiled, conceived twins by him. In Egypt he offered himself as a slave in place of Benjamin, and Jacob's blessing gave him the sceptre.
body: When the brothers have Joseph in the pit, Judah asks what they gain by killing him, and they sell him to Ishmaelites instead. He then leaves his brothers, marries a Canaanite, and has three sons.
His dealings with Tamar end with his own verdict: “She is more righteous than I.” Her son Perez carries on his line.

In Egypt it is Judah who pledges himself for Benjamin to his father, and Judah who pleads before Joseph, not knowing who he is, offering to stay as a slave so the boy can go home. Jacob's blessing gives him the praise of his brothers and a sceptre that will not depart. Hebrews notes that Jesus descended from Judah.

moments.text: Offers to stay as a slave
